key_concepts: quaternion channels x, y, z, w
Euler input and output rotation order
Sample Rate Match and time slicing
common_gotchas: Quaternion input requires four channels in x, y, z, w order.
Two-vector mode expects six channels: one xyz vector followed by a second orthogonal xyz vector.
Euler conversions depend on input and output rotation order; mismatched orders can look like axis flips or gimbal artifacts.
Unit conversion is not a transform-space conversion; confirm channel naming and component order before exporting to COMP rotations.
